title: RelayVSR video super-resolution framework released
summary: RelayVSR is an open-source video super-resolution framework that combines a sparse generative keyframe backbone with a lightweight Dual-Memory Video Transformer to upscale and enhance degraded video. Running at up to 29 FPS at 1080p on an NVIDIA A100 GPU with approximately 13.8 GB peak VRAM, the model supports 2x and 4x enhancement and integrates into local inference pipelines including ComfyUI.
research_notes:
Clone the repository and install required dependencies including PyTorch and torchvision.

Download pretrained RelayVSR model weights from Hugging Face for the 2x or 4x enhancement target.

Run inference via the provided test scripts or ComfyUI custom nodes using streaming mode for long video sequences.

Use a keyframe interval such as 15 frames to maintain high throughput while preserving generative detail reconstruction.

Enable streaming mode with linear cross-fading when processing long sequences to keep VRAM usage stable and eliminate chunk boundary artifacts.

Allocate a GPU with at least 14 GB VRAM to accommodate peak memory during keyframe latent generation.
